_설명: 그림에 나올 인물 외모를 미리 정해 두는 곳. look = 그림 모델에 넣는 영어 묘사(모든 컷에 그대로), look_ko = 한국어 설명, face = 얼굴 기준 그림(있으면 얼굴 검수·수정에 씀)

chars.name: 바다 할아버지
chars.look: old Korean fisherman in his 70s, short white hair, short white beard, wrinkled kind face, tanned skin, navy blue knit cap, faded yellow raincoat, brown rubber boots
chars.look_ko: 70대 어부, 짧은 흰머리·흰 수염, 주름진 인자한 얼굴, 그을린 피부, 남색 털모자, 빛바랜 노란 우비, 갈색 장화

chars.name: 하나
chars.look: 8-year-old Korean girl, black hair in two short pigtails with red ribbons, round face, rosy cheeks, light blue dress, white cardigan
chars.look_ko: 8살 손녀, 빨간 리본 단 짧은 양갈래 검은 머리, 동그란 얼굴, 발그레한 볼, 하늘색 원피스, 흰 카디건

chars.name: 조조
chars.look: Chinese Eastern Han dynasty (c. 200 AD) man in his 30s-40s, sharp narrow eyes, black hair in a small topknot, thin black mustache and small goatee, dark navy-blue long robe with wide sleeves, bronze-brown lamellar chest armor with shoulder plates, tan front apron panel, dark boots
chars.look_ko: 30~40대, 날카로운 눈, 작은 상투, 가는 콧수염·작은 턱수염, 남색 도포 + 구릿빛 비늘 가슴갑옷·어깨갑옷, 황갈색 앞치마

chars.name: 진수
chars.look: Chinese Eastern Han dynasty (c. 200 AD) scholar historian in his 50s, calm face, black hair in a topknot with small black cap, thin mustache and short goatee, teal-green long scholar robe with dark sash
chars.look_ko: 50대 역사가, 차분한 얼굴, 상투에 작은 검은 관, 가는 콧수염·짧은 턱수염, 청록색 학자 도포

chars.name: 배송지
chars.look: Chinese Eastern Han dynasty (c. 200 AD) scholar official in his 50s, square face, tall black official cap, grey mustache and long grey beard, mustard-yellow long robe with brown sash
chars.look_ko: 50대 학자 관리, 각진 얼굴, 높은 검은 관모, 회색 수염, 겨자색 도포에 갈색 띠

chars.name: 관우
chars.look: Chinese Eastern Han dynasty (c. 200 AD) tall general, dark red face, long flowing black beard, green head wrap, dark green robe over dark scale armor
chars.look_ko: 붉은 얼굴, 긴 검은 수염, 녹색 두건, 녹색 전포 + 검은 비늘갑옷

chars.name: 나관중
chars.look: Chinese Eastern Han dynasty (c. 200 AD) elderly writer, thin grey beard, black cloth cap, plain light grey long robe
chars.look_ko: 노년 작가, 성긴 회색 수염, 검은 천 모자, 연회색 도포

chars.name: 서영
chars.look: Chinese Eastern Han dynasty (c. 200 AD) general, dark iron helmet, black hooded cloak, grey scale armor, mustache and goatee
chars.look_ko: 검은 투구, 검은 망토, 회색 비늘갑옷, 콧수염·턱수염

chars.name: 손견
chars.look: Chinese Eastern Han dynasty (c. 200 AD) general in his 30s, red headscarf (red head wrap), short black beard, crimson robe under steel lamellar armor
chars.look_ko: 붉은 두건, 짧은 검은 수염, 진홍 전포 + 강철 비늘갑옷

chars.name: 여포
chars.look: Chinese Eastern Han dynasty (c. 200 AD) muscular warrior, silver helmet with long pheasant tail feather, silver scale armor, white trousers, short beard
chars.look_ko: 근육질, 긴 꿩깃 은투구, 은빛 비늘갑옷, 흰 바지

chars.name: 원술
chars.look: Chinese Eastern Han dynasty (c. 200 AD) nobleman, black topknot, mustache, purple long robe with gold trim
chars.look_ko: 상투, 콧수염, 금테 두른 보라색 도포

chars.name: 유비
chars.look: Chinese Eastern Han dynasty (c. 200 AD) man in his 30s, short beard, brown head cloth, beige robe with brown leather armor
chars.look_ko: 짧은 수염, 갈색 두건, 베이지 도포 + 갈색 가죽갑옷

chars.name: 이야기꾼
chars.look: Chinese Eastern Han dynasty (c. 200 AD) old storyteller, white hair in a topknot, long white beard, navy-blue robe with yellow sash
chars.look_ko: 흰 상투, 긴 흰 수염, 남색 도포에 노란 띠

chars.name: 조무
chars.look: Chinese Eastern Han dynasty (c. 200 AD) young officer, clean-shaven, black topknot, brown leather armor, light green trousers
chars.look_ko: 젊은 장교, 수염 없음, 상투, 갈색 가죽갑옷, 연두 바지

chars.name: 호진
chars.look: Chinese Eastern Han dynasty (c. 200 AD) heavyset older general, grey beard, ornate gold helmet, gold patterned armor over dark maroon robe
chars.look_ko: 덩치 큰 노장, 회색 수염, 금 투구, 금빛 갑옷 + 짙은 자주 전포

chars.name: 화웅
chars.look: Chinese Eastern Han dynasty (c. 200 AD) stout general, full black beard, black iron helmet, black lamellar armor, brown cloak
chars.look_ko: 다부진 체격, 덥수룩한 검은 수염, 검은 투구·검은 비늘갑옷, 갈색 망토
